notes.title: Notes de patch MAJ 1.0 : La sortie officielle !
notes.notes:

Most of the changes have already been listed in this post from August 26, so to avoid repeating myself I recommend you read this:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2992460/view/541114656762102406?l=english"][/dynamiclink]

added lots of stats in the stats tab (some will remember previous actions, some won't)

fixed interacting with the satanas help button when skipping text during the tutorial

notes.title: [1.0 BETA] TRY OUT THE BIGGEST SOUL PARK UPDATE EVER!

notes.title: A preview of the future 1.0 update!
notes.notes:
Hey!I haven't posted any update here in a while, so let me update you on what's coming soon (hopefully) for SOUL PARK: I'm working on THE OFFICIAL RELEASE!!! Let me show you some of the things I have planned for 1.0. 

1. New build type : employee stations!
These little fellas will help you with repepepepepetitive tasks around the park, provided you pay them enough and let them go on vacation! Hell it's hard to be a good boss…


[previewyoutube="z3xL7eJ6VMA;full"][/previewyoutube]

2. New theme: History!
A colorful mix of monuments and artifacts from different eras, including the game's biggest ride yet: the Roman Arena! Its minigame is one of my favorite I ever made ~


[previewyoutube="DhPodUIvtQY;full"][/previewyoutube]

3. Reworked mini-games
Ride mini-games just got a lot more serious! Earn experience based on your performance, like how fast you complete it, or how much HP you got left!


[previewyoutube="6snxjrnAeoU;full"][/previewyoutube]

4. Satanas's challenge
A new challenge awaits you at night! Instead of fighting off corruption or going to Chester's lair, you can now play against Satanas in a high stake marble game!


[previewyoutube="DxQdKDKUhnw;full"][/previewyoutube]

5. Corrupted pyramids rides!
Those pyramids surrounding your park finally have a use! Use a cursed key you earned in Satanas's challenge to convert one of the pyramids into a brand new and exclusive ride!


[previewyoutube="PbGxzFh_8zg;full"][/previewyoutube]

6. New ride sounds
Roam around your park and listen to the new sounds of your favorite rides!


[previewyoutube="F_a2FL1UdY0;full"][/previewyoutube]

7. In-game wiki!
Need a refresher course in park management? Open the wiki and get all your answers!


[previewyoutube="WzU3M3khPN4;full"][/previewyoutube]

All with new camera movements...
Navigating around your park will be smoother than ever!




While most things shown here are in a nearly finished state, I still have some cards up my sleeves that I can't quite reveal yet. I'm working hard to give you the full experience and I hope you'll like it, so hold on tight, some cool things are on the way! - CLEDU

notes.title: UPDATE 0.29.0 DAY & NIGHT
notes.notes:
Satanas is shaking up the rhythm of the game!

Every 3 minutes, night sets in and gives the player new possibilities: will you try to regain ground from corruption? Or will you go visit CHESTER, the new treasurer of the underworld? For the occasion, the park interface has been refined to better match the atmosphere of the game. There are many other changes, namely: new currencies, new dialogues, new animations, and a major economic rebalancing to boost your purchasing power in the game.

The next update will be a bit smaller and should complete what was imagined for this one but could not be implemented yet. Expect a second new character, a thematic reinforcement of the SOUL PARK universe, and a new mechanic to prevent tears of corruption from spawning during the day!

I imagined this update with my girlfriend Maryne, which unofficially makes it the first update released as an independent game studio rather than as a solo developer!
Thank you to everyone that is a part of our small community, your trust and fervor will pay off!

FULL CHANGELOG

DAY/NIGHT CYCLE
The game now cycles through 3 minutes long days, alternating with night phases that you can end at any time.
 the sky's colors now shift as the day goes on
 you can see the progress of the day in the new UI
 loading a save will now also load how far into the day/night cycle you were when you last saved
 When night time comes, the new CAGES MINIGAME starts:
 every customer still in your park heads towards the exit, while you try to sort them by eye color in their corresponding cage.
 innocent customers' eyes are black, guilty ones can be yellow, blue, red, purple or green
 you get more or less soul fragments as a reward depending on how well you sorted them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057816/cfcf92aa7349cd03cd17bcd9649a80e4d8a9ab76.png
 after the minigame, you can perform up to two (2) actions, whether it is attacking corruption, and visiting CHESTER, SOUL PARK's new treasurer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057816/bf5e84a668d1f42770f74e26a8d704bb99b33d15.png

notes.title: 0.28.2 THE LEGACY UPDATE is HERE!
notes.notes:
YOU SHALL CRAWL!

God is NOT happy with you! He put a curse on you and Satanas and now you're both doomed to rebuild your park over and over again! This is no easy task, as you will have to earn every piece of the new and improved progress tree all by yourself! Will you succeed and thrive nonetheless?

PATCH NOTES


NEW - LEGACY GAME MODE
Legacy is a time limited game mode: you have 13 in-game days (= 13 minutes) to build a park. On the 14th day, the park is destroyed and you have to start over, keeping only your player level, unlocked products, and completed achievements. This is to encourage players to try different approaches and better manage their park.
In a future update, additional rewards and statistics will be given at the end of a cycle.
- added a button to access legacy from the main menu
